svg.title: The Math of ClickHouse CAS on AWS: Collapsing R× S3 Storage and Cross-AZ Replication to 1×
svg.desc: Comparison of stock ClickHouse ReplicatedMergeTree per-replica S3 storage (r copies of 1.974 TB/day compressed at 30 TB/day raw ingest = $14,359/mo at r=10 or $2,872-$4,308/mo sharded at 33-day retention, plus $4,800-$8,000/mo if multi-AZ) versus Altinity Antalya Content-Addressed Storage (CAS, metadata_type=cas) over the free S3 Gateway Endpoint (1x shared S3 pool = $1,436/mo at 33d or $318/mo at 7d, $0/GB cross-AZ transfer, and $2,355-$3,473/mo total end-to-end COGS).

g.text: The Math of ClickHouse CAS on AWS: From R× Copies to 1× Shared Pool
30 TB/day raw logs (912,000 GB/mo) · 15.2× ZSTD = 1.974 TB/day compressed · Free S3 Gateway Endpoint ($0/GB wire)
STOCK REPLICATEDMERGETREE (R× COPIES)
1. Per-Replica Prefix Multiplication: data/tiered/{replica}/
Upstream zero-copy is deprecated. Every replica uploads its own physical
copy of every cold part. On a 1-shard 10-slot cluster, 2.32 TiB of unique
parts becomes 23.23 TiB across writer-0..4, reader-0..3, and backup-0.
2. Cold S3 Cost by Topology (30 TB/day)
• Unsharded 10 replicas (r = 10): $3,178/mo (7d) · $14,359/mo (33d)
• Unsharded 6 replicas (r = 6): $1,907/mo (7d) · $8,615/mo (33d)
• Sharded 3×3 Zero-Lag (r = 3): $953/mo (7d) · $4,308/mo (33d)
• Sharded 3×2 Bounded (r = 2): $636/mo (7d) · $2,872/mo (33d)
3. R× S3 PUT Amplification & Scale-Out Re-Uploads
Every replica independently merges and PUTs cold parts to its own prefix.
Every ASG scale-out replacement downloads and re-uploads cold parts.
S3 API: ~$180-$220/mo tuned (up to $1,395-$2,550/mo untuned)
4. Multi-AZ Peer Replication Tax ($0.02/GB over TCP :9010)
Spreading replicas across 3 AZs fetches parts peer-to-peer over EC2 TCP.
1.974 TB/d × 30.4d × 4..6.7 cross-AZ hops × $20/TB:
Cross-AZ Transfer Tax: +$4,800 to +$8,000/mo ($58k-$96k/yr)
Unoptimized 1-Shard (r=10, 33d): ~$26,555/mo (2.91¢/GB)
Tuned Sharded GA (r=2, 7d): $2,743/mo (0.30¢/GB)
ALTINITY ANTALYA CAS (1× SHARED POOL)
1. Content-Addressed Shared Pool: cas/tiered/ & cas/<tenant>/
metadata_type = cas stores each part blob ONCE under its content hash.
No {replica} in endpoint_subpath; each server mounts with cas_server_root_id
= {replica}. Replicas publish tiny manifest refs and relink via HEAD.
Formula: Cold_S3 = 1 × 1.974 TB/d × D_rate (independent of R!)
2. Cold S3 Cost with CAS (r = 1 regardless of replica count)
• 7-day raw retention (13.82 TB Std): $318/mo (saves $318-$2,860/mo)
• 33-day raw retention (65.13 TB): $1,436/mo (saves $1,436-$12,923/mo)
• Extra 30d retention COGS uplift: +$0.0015/GB (halved vs r=2)
• Scale-out reader hydration: 0 blob bytes copied in S3
3. Single-Replica Merge + Relink (3600s Threshold)
execute_merges_on_single_replica_time_threshold = 3600: one replica merges
cold parts and writes the blob once; peers relink by hash without PUTting.
S3 API: ~$110/mo at 30 TB/day (60-80% fewer cold Tier-1 PUTs)
4. Multi-AZ via Free S3 Gateway Endpoint ($0/GB Cross-AZ)
With every VPC route table + user-data + backup pinned to regional S3,
cold blobs cross AZs through regional S3 at $0/GB instead of EC2 :9010.
Cross-AZ Transfer: ~$15-$40/mo (avoids +$4,800-$8,000/mo tax)
Target Floor (CAS r=1, 7d + 1-yr SP): ~$2,355/mo (0.26¢/GB)
Target Floor (CAS r=1, 33d + 1-yr SP): ~$3,473/mo (0.38¢/GB)
Saves up to $12,923/mo on S3 storage + $4,800-$8,000/mo on Multi-AZ
